# Welcome to Winter Rift 2025 (Season 5) - Day Version:

## INFO:
Map Forcer is needed to play this mod! Download here: [Mod Link](https://runeforge.dev/mods/d410324f-3b6d-4dde-9f2e-fad097454ae4)

Project Rey Discord: [Invite](https://discord.gg/pjXSSsmwPF)

## 
Download and conquer the snow in this chilling showcase of Summoner's Rift's winter side!

## About the Mod:

Explore Winter Rift 2025, a frosty transformation of the classic 2017 version. Immerse yourself in the icy depths of Summoner's Rift with this custom map skin, featuring a captivating recolor inspired by the cold mysteries of the Rift.

## Changes:

* Full recolor of the Summoners Rift map to Snowdown 2017
* All Jungle Camps and Mobs are supported and fully recolored
* Snowdown Minions
* Snowdown Turrets / Nexus & Inhibitors
* Default Map 
* Default Turrets & Minions
* Runeforge ground on topside
* Snow Particles

## Credits:

* TheKillerey - Full map recovery 
* Nagi - Creating topside Runeforge ground
* BlooJae - Giving me the Runeforge ground from 2024 version
* Xllwd - Fixing the default turret's destruction
